response.sql:
WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally,
         CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_tallies
)
SELECT archstat AS status,
       tally,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()

assumptions.assumption: A project is counted once per archival status, even if it has multiple QC records with that status; a project appearing under multiple statuses is counted in each applicable status.

alternatives.interpretation: Count QC records rather than distinct projects in each status.
